verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents non-interactive automation paths: an official CLI (pspace), a Core RESTful API, and a JavaScript SDK, all authenticated with API keys. Machines can be created through the API or CLI, and Workflows automate ML pipelines in code, so headless operation is clearly supported. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions, CI token setup), and independent or hands-on confirmation of headless/CI use.
